They are super feathery looking and I got a lot of compliments.

Great lashes for a first time lash user. I agree with another reviewer, they do take a bit of practice to get used to and were a bit long for my taste. But once I tried them out a few times and trimmed them down a bit I was very happy with end results. They stayed on for the entire 6 hours I wore them for an event without any lifting and I pretty much forgot I was even wearing them as they are so lightweight. Love that package includes 3 different styles. Great product at a great price.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the lashes as easy to use, especially for beginners and first-time lash users.
Many reviewers praise the natural, cute, or feathery look and the variety of styles included.
Several reviewers note that the magnetic liner must dry fully before applying the lashes, and some mention it takes a while to dry.
A few reviewers report durability problems, including lashes falling off or liner flaking off before desired.
Some reviewers mention needing to trim or adjust the lashes, or that the magnets are spaced too far apart.
